INSERT INTO msp_cache.cache_ocs_computers (
  ocs_id, workgroup, name, os, os_version, cpu, cpu_cores, cpu_speed_mhz,
  ram_mb, disk_gb, disk_type, ip, mac, bios_serial, last_contact, username,
  disk_used_pct, disk_health, disk_hours_on, last_kb_update, kb_count_30d,
  is_virtual, uptime_days, hardware_uuid,
  disks_json, memory_slots_json, networks_json, drives_json,
  synced_at
)
SELECT
  x.ocs_id, NULLIF(x.workgroup,''), NULLIF(x.name,''), NULLIF(x.os,''), NULLIF(x.os_version,''),
  NULLIF(x.cpu,''), x.cpu_cores, x.cpu_speed_mhz,
  x.ram_mb, x.disk_gb, NULLIF(x.disk_type,''),
  CASE WHEN x.ip ~ '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' THEN x.ip::inet ELSE NULL END,
  NULLIF(x.mac,''), NULLIF(x.bios_serial,''),
  CASE WHEN x.last_contact ~ '^[12][0-9]{3}-' THEN x.last_contact::timestamptz ELSE NULL END,
  NULLIF(x.username,''),
  x.disk_used_pct, NULLIF(x.disk_health,''), x.disk_hours_on,
  CASE WHEN x.last_kb_update ~ '^[12][0-9]{3}-' THEN x.last_kb_update::timestamptz ELSE NULL END,
  x.kb_count_30d, x.is_virtual, x.uptime_days, NULLIF(x.hardware_uuid,''),
  NULLIF(x.disks_json,'')::jsonb,
  NULLIF(x.memory_slots_json,'')::jsonb,
  NULLIF(x.networks_json,'')::jsonb,
  NULLIF(x.drives_json,'')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
  ocs_id integer, workgroup text, name text, os text, os_version text,
  cpu text, cpu_cores integer, cpu_speed_mhz integer,
  ram_mb integer, disk_gb integer, disk_type text,
  ip text, mac text, bios_serial text,
  last_contact text, username text,
  disk_used_pct smallint, disk_health text, disk_hours_on integer,
  last_kb_update text, kb_count_30d smallint,
  is_virtual boolean, uptime_days integer, hardware_uuid text,
  disks_json text, memory_slots_json text, networks_json text, drives_json text
)
ON CONFLICT (ocs_id) DO UPDATE SET
  workgroup=EXCLUDED.workgroup, name=EXCLUDED.name,
  os=EXCLUDED.os, os_version=EXCLUDED.os_version,
  cpu=EXCLUDED.cpu, cpu_cores=EXCLUDED.cpu_cores, cpu_speed_mhz=EXCLUDED.cpu_speed_mhz,
  ram_mb=EXCLUDED.ram_mb, disk_gb=EXCLUDED.disk_gb, disk_type=EXCLUDED.disk_type,
  ip=EXCLUDED.ip, mac=EXCLUDED.mac, bios_serial=EXCLUDED.bios_serial,
  last_contact=EXCLUDED.last_contact, username=EXCLUDED.username,
  disk_used_pct=EXCLUDED.disk_used_pct, disk_health=EXCLUDED.disk_health,
  disk_hours_on=EXCLUDED.disk_hours_on, last_kb_update=EXCLUDED.last_kb_update,
  kb_count_30d=EXCLUDED.kb_count_30d, is_virtual=EXCLUDED.is_virtual,
  uptime_days=EXCLUDED.uptime_days, hardware_uuid=EXCLUDED.hardware_uuid,
  disks_json=EXCLUDED.disks_json, memory_slots_json=EXCLUDED.memory_slots_json,
  networks_json=EXCLUDED.networks_json, drives_json=EXCLUDED.drives_json,
  synced_at=NOW()
